The release value is `window.applicationVersion`, and it is set by the new `--application-version` flag on the `openmrs assemble` CLI.

- **Supplied at assembly:** `openmrs assemble --application-version <v>` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:345-350`) writes it as the top-level `version` in the routes registry (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/assemble.ts:392-399`). The flag is documented in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:166`. Note the flag is named `--application-version`, not `--release`.
- **Exposed at runtime:** the shell reads `initialRouteMap.version` and defines `window.applicationVersion` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/run.ts:104-124`). Only the value `prerelease` is rewritten, to a localized "Local" or "Prerelease" label.
- **Shown by default:** the login page renders it under the form (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx:258`). The primary navbar renders it too (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-primary-navigation-app/src/components/navbar/navbar.component.tsx:65`). Both render only when the value is truthy.
- **When nobody sets it:** the flag defaults to `undefined` and the registry omits `version`. `window.applicationVersion` is then `undefined` and nothing is rendered on the sign-in page. This is not the `local` default, which belongs to `window.spaVersion` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/src/index.ts:51-55`).
- **Change that added it:** commit `9f0c6aa831f37ffcaf167a7096b07ec3e96a0431`, "(feat) Add a distribution-controlled version property (#1815)", by Ian, co-authored by Dennis Kigen, 2026-08-21. Its message names PR #1815 but no ticket key, so I have no ticket to cite.

I only read `openmrs-esm-core`; the other O3 repositories were not checked.
